name: Fractured Lunar Iron
desc:
A fragment taken from within a defeated ancient machine that had wandered the lunar surface. It seems unlike the metals commonly found in Teyvat.
Lost folktales from many lands tell of heroes who forged the "divine iron" granted by the Welkin Moon into indestructible weapons, then used them to defeat fearsome foes and monsters.

customize.name: Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network
customize.desc:
An ancient machine trapped amongst the lunar ruins. Even the sturdiest and most reliable machines will be conquered by the passing of long years, losing the purpose bestowed upon them by their creators. Now, this entity only attacks and eliminates anything that dares set foot on the ground it defends.
In the records of a long-lost ancient civilization, these out-of-control machines were once called "Ur-Namrasit-Tilimtu-Babbar," or "the one who brings light to the darkness." With a yearning for the boundless sea of stars, the leaders of the "pioneers" engraved their most earnest words in golden sigils, hoping that their successors, with the help of these assistants, would be able to keep the light that illuminates the universe shining bright.
Alas, the light did not arise for anyone, and the machine that was given the title of "overseer" did not manage to wait for the one it should have served. Now, stranded in these ruins, it is but the last, out-of-control remnant of a long-lost ideal.

customize.name: "Mushteshir"
customize.desc: The first "Precursor's Secret Source Matrix of Overseer Network" ever to remain upon the lunar surface. It is said to be a prototype built by the dragon researcher Maagees-Geti. It was originally created as a cooperative mechanism to aid in lunar research. But as time passed, it was entrusted with power and responsibilities far beyond the purpose for which it had first been designed. The one who made it has long since forgotten the name "Mushteshir." Yet the machine still remembers the duty bound to that name: to be a guide, a pioneer, and an eternal sentinel watching over the stars that have yet to be reached.

customize.name: Masterless Stardust
customize.desc:
Currency used to purchase rare resources from the Shop.
Surplus Stardust of destiny. Perhaps it can create new destinies when in large enough quantities.

customize.name: A Teaspoon of Transcendence
customize.desc: An object of fantasy with countless definitions amidst an endless sea of stories. On the grand scale of the universe or the realm of dreams, there is no real difference between the holy sword of the brave warrior and the princess's teaspoon, or between the ice-cold clockspring and the key that will unlock the gates of transcendence...

customize.name: Depleted Lunar Iron
customize.desc:
A component taken from within a defeated ancient machine that had wandered the lunar surface. It seems unlike the metals commonly found in Teyvat.
Lost folktales from many lands tell of heroes who forged the "divine iron" granted by the Welkin Moon into indestructible weapons, then used them to defeat fearsome foes and monsters. But the metal that fell from the Welkin Moon was no divine blessing — even the gods who once resided upon the moon had long since fallen.

customize.name: Unblemished Lunar Iron
customize.desc:
A core taken from within a defeated ancient machine that had wandered the lunar surface. It seems unlike the metals commonly found in Teyvat.
It was untouched by earthly impurity, eternal and free from the seven calamities and eight sufferings, and it once longed to sing out into the endless void. Yet when every calculation reached its end, all that remained in the lunar palace was useless, cold iron.
